_comment: bb-auth users file (JSON) — the REAL access gate (Cognito self-signup is open).
Re-checked on every /auth/validate, so removing a user + `systemctl reload bb-auth`
(SIGHUP) denies even existing sessions; a plain restart works too. Emails match
case-insensitively. Keys are addressed by `key_hash` = SHA-256 of the bbk_ bearer
(mint with tools/bb-apikey.py); the raw key is never stored here. `duration`:
`authorized_urls` are full <scheme>://<host>/<path> patterns and they are the whole
grant: ACCESS IS ENUMERATED, NEVER ASSUMED. A user with no authorized_urls (or an
empty list) reaches nothing. To grant everything, say so: ['*://*/*'].
A key without the field inherits its user's scope.
Wildcards, valid in every component: `*` = any run of characters but never `/` —
EXCEPT as the final character, where it swallows the rest of the URL, slashes
included; `&` = exactly one character, never `/`. So `/mcp/*` covers the whole /mcp
subtree while `/mcp*` would also match /mcp-admin — always put the `/` before the
`*`. And `/mcp/*` does NOT match a bare `/mcp`; list both if the client hits it.
Validate a file before deploying it: `bb-auth --check-users FILE`.
Unknown fields (this _comment, per-key `notes`) are ignored, so use them freely.

users.notes: browser login, confined to the app host
listed but reaches nothing — an empty list is a deliberate lockout

api_keys.notes: example only — replace key_hash with one from tools/bb-apikey.py
